what: Put down, then do the whole survey (tunnel-09 aisle, yard, tunnel-10 aisle, dock) - scripts/offpath_mission_eval.py
how_it_works: belief = the camera's pick (near) or the LiDAR's best guess (far)
plan: rejoin the taught path at the nearest reachable point, then tunnel-09 aisle, yard, tunnel-10 aisle, dock
every 0.25 m: scan vs map at the believed place (HypothesisTracker); every 10 m a fresh whole-map search adds rivals

a belief that stops fitting, an obstacle where the map says free, or a rival that fits clearly better for >= 2 m => new anchor; the whole odometry history is re-placed, plant records relabelled, mission goals re-derived
no candidate can plan => step 2 m into open space and search again
at the dock: Nemotron VL compares the view with the dock and with the strongest far rival before docking
caveats: LiDAR scans are synthetic (ray-cast on the self-built map); no sensor noise
the live camera view at the dock check stands in from the look-around image set, taken >= 1.5 m from the reference image

two identical houses + two yards make the farm nearly symmetric for a 2-D LiDAR: 12 of 17 wrong starts were resolved by the camera at the dock, after a complete but wrongly labelled survey that was then relabelled
